# CasaVargas

> Casa Vargas LLC is an independent software studio in North Carolina, founded by Jon Vargas. It makes apps for the Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Windows and Linux, sold as one-time purchases or free, with no subscriptions.

Each product below has a case study on this site (why it exists, what it does, how it's built) and, where it has shipped, its own product site or store listing. The product's own site is the source of truth for prices and features.
Expanded, one-paragraph-per-product version of this file: https://casavargas.app/llms-full.txt

## Available now

- [Beltr](https://casavargas.app/work/beltr/): Karaoke from the music you already own. Separates vocals on your own computer, times lyrics word by word, and turns phones into mics. macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker. $19.99 once, five songs free. Product site: https://beltr.app
- [Beltr Remote and Beltr Client](https://casavargas.app/work/beltr/): Free companion apps: Remote for iPhone and Android, Client for Apple TV and Android TV.
- [OneScribe](https://casavargas.app/work/onescribe/): A document scanner for iPhone and iPad that reads what it scans into structured Data Cards for dozens of document types, on the device. Free to scan; Pro is $9.99 once. Product site: https://getonescribe.app

## Open source

- [DebridDownloader](https://casavargas.app/work/debrid-downloader/): A GPL-3.0 desktop client for Real-Debrid, TorBox and Premiumize, built with Tauri, Rust and React. Source: https://github.com/CasaVargas/DebridDownloader
- [Deckle](https://casavargas.app/deckle/): The app for your e-ink reader. Prints a real morning newspaper on your Kindle, Kobo, PocketBook, reMarkable or iPad (the Deckle Daily), built on your own computer from your town's news and weather, your feeds and saved articles; and turns EPUBs, Markdown, Word documents and PDFs you own into Kindle books that read like the store's (Enhanced Typesetting, a cover that stays, page numbers, X-Ray, Word Wise). macOS and Windows; Kindle books need Amazon's free Kindle Previewer 4, other readers need nothing else. GPL-3.0-or-later, pre-alpha 0.6.0; Kindles verified on hardware, other readers simulated so far. Not affiliated with Amazon or any reader's maker. Case study: https://casavargas.app/work/deckle/ Source: https://github.com/CasaVargas/deckle

## In development

- [Cathode TV](https://casavargas.app/work/cathode-tv/): A native IPTV player for your own M3U or Xtream playlists and XMLTV guides, on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Vision Pro. Due in 2026. Product site: https://cathodetv.app
- [Nimbus](https://casavargas.app/work/nimbus/): A native Mac app that puts S3, Google Drive, OneDrive, SFTP and other storage into Finder, driven by rclone.
- [AppPulse](https://casavargas.app/work/apppulse/) (working title): A Mac app updater that installs an update only after verifying it comes from the same developer as the installed app.
